annotations.title: Edit a Reddit catalog, feed or product set

description: Change a Reddit catalog (kind "catalog": its name or attached pixelIds — currency and language are fixed), a product FEED (kind "feed": url, mode, name, credentials or its schedule, including pausing it with schedule.isPaused) or a PRODUCT SET (kind "product_set": name or filter, same rule format as create_reddit_ads_product_set). A changed product-set filter changes what every catalog ad group using that set advertises, immediately — say so before doing it. Read back from Reddit.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

id.description: the catalog, feed or product set id

kind.description: catalog, feed or product_set: which type the id refers to

pixelIds.description: catalog only — replaces the attached pixels

schedule.description: feed only — same shape as create_reddit_ads_product_feed

name: update_reddit_ads_catalog_object
title: Edit a Reddit catalog, feed or product set
